verdict.delta_sentence: Compared with the nearer intent-classification-2 reference, this board has similarly clear semantic color and sectioning but weaker frame balance, longer routing detours, and a much larger unproductive central band.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: FAIL: The top traffic strip, middle regional row, and bottom data/control panels leave an oversized empty vertical band through the center and substantial unused space below the committed content.

sub_checks.name: corridors_and_air
sub_checks.note: Most nodes and edge chips have generous breathing room, although the extreme spacing between the regional row and bottom panels turns useful air into compositional dead space.

sub_checks.name: grouping
sub_checks.note: Tinted, titled regions clearly separate global traffic, three regional deployments, global data/payments, and the failover control plane, with the repeated regional grouping especially easy to scan.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Blue traffic, teal regional infrastructure, purple shared data, orange control, green success, and red promotion states form a consistent semantic palette rather than decorative noise.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: No crosshair junctions or obvious waypoint glyphs are exposed, but the unlabeled blue three-way branch above the regional panels reads somewhat like routing scaffolding.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: The three regional panels maintain strong repeated registers, but the bottom panels have unequal widths and baselines, and the isolated middle void breaks the board's vertical rhythm.

sub_checks.name: edge_legibility
sub_checks.note: FAIL: Edges avoid crossings, but the blue regional fan-out and purple database-to-replication route make long orthogonal detours across large empty areas, while the dashed decisions route spans much of the lower board.

verdict.rank_order_sanity_note: The visual ordering and assigned scores agree: gc-decomp-harness (7.5) ranks first, intent-classification-2 (7.0) second, and the board under grade (6.5) third.
